QADB stores only a small set of verified procedures and stable preferences locally, then retrieves relevant items per task. It never stores screenshots, UI trees, full chats, typed message bodies, contacts, verification codes, passwords, or API keys. You can review, edit, disable, or clear memory at any time in Settings.

Memory is stored only in a local SQLite database. QADB never stores screenshots, raw UI XML, full chats, typed message bodies, contacts, verification codes, passwords, API keys, or Authorization headers.
This permanently deletes every entry in the local memory database and cannot be undone.
